thread.text:
⚡ dot-product-demo: Three ways to multiply a million numbers, measured on this machine.

Speedup: 341.3x · numpy dot: 0.12 ms · python loop: 40.96 ms

https://github.com/Bobliuuu/video-readme-maker

The problem:
• Plain Python loops pay interpreter overhead on every element
• A million elements means a million bytecode steps
• Speed matters when this sits in a hot path

Results:
• Speedup: 341.3x
• numpy dot: 0.12 ms
• python loop: 40.96 ms

Honest caveats:
• Timings come from one machine and one session, best of several repetitions.
• Absolute numbers will differ on your hardware; the ratio is what matters.
